description: Namur - Relief (Modèle numérique de terrain) is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Relief de Namur fourni au format GeoTif 1 bande de couleur correspondant aux altitudes en mètre. Egalement converti en courbes de niveau et fourni aux formats DXF et SHP. Vu l'étendue de la commune de Namur, l'image a été coupée en 4 parties + une zone supplémentaire pour la zone centrale. Coverage: Namur. The portal files it under Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are Relief, modèle numérique de terrain, pente, MNT, Namur3D, Courbe niveau. The portal shows 5 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
